item.text:
The sparse edit closely reproduces the donor’s early residual change: at layer 8, the change vectors have cosine similarity 0.989, leaving only 16.6% of the original donor-base gap. Its output behavior remains only partly donor-like: “The” is still the top continuation on 55 of 64 discovery questions, versus 59 for the base and 13 for the donor. The probes show increased letter probability even without a question, plus smaller question-dependent effects. I will now test whether the previously helpful downstream patches become less useful after this early transfer, which would support their role as readers of an upstream change rather than its local weight source.
